title: Splash Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the heart of Seaside on Natchez Street, Splash is a custom built and updated 4 bedroom home directly across the street from the white, sandy beaches of iconic Seaside.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Directly across the street from the Natchez Private Seaside Beach Pavilion - You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - 3 King Suites and 1 Queen suite - Amazing Views from the home - 2 adult beach cruiser bikes - Fully Stocked Kitchen - 2 parking passes - Bedrooms on main level - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $112/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). Located in the heart of Seaside on Natchez Street, Splash is a custom built and updated 4 bedroom home directly across the street from the white, sandy beaches of iconic Seaside. Sitting prominently at the entrance to Natchez Street, Splash is just steps away from beach. The front porch encompasses the full width of the house and is defined by the stout columns. Step inside the foyer and the unique personality of this unpretentious beach cottage begins to unfold. Natural finished maple floors compliment the white painted framed wood panels and wainscoting used throughout the home. The central hall has separate accesses to the three guest bedrooms and baths. French doors off two guest bedrooms lead to a verandah tucked behind a grove of mature oaks and native landscaping. The KING master suite is positioned at the rear of the house for privacy. The screen porch off the master suite provides a retreat to escape with your favorite book. Stairs off the foyer lead to the second level living area with half bath. Peaked roof ceilings with exposed beams add dimension to the space. Two linen slip covered sofas with swivel club chairs anchor the living room. A glass top table with wicker chairs is ready for a game of checkers and serves as extra dining. The dining area includes a large oval tabletop made of reclaimed pine with a metal base, upholstered banquette seating with storage and slip covered chairs. The cohesive floor plan also includes a complete remodel of the kitchen area- quartzite counter tops, new cabinetry, and high-end appliances. French doors and tall windows ensure plenty of natural light. The ambiance of the room changes during the day as the sun rises and sets. A spiral stair leads to the enclosed tower with balcony and gulf views from east to west offering both town and water views. *All of the 4 Bedrooms are located on the first level* Floor 1: - KING master retreat, TV, with private en-suite bath, separate tub and shower - KING bedroom (sleeps 2) with private en-suite bath (Shower only) that connects to the outdoor shower - KING bedroom with TV Shared hall bath Jack-and Jill style (shower only) - QUEEN Bedroom Floor 2: Kitchen, 2 dining spaces, large living area with flat screen TV, half bath Floor 3: Up the spiral staircase is the viewing tower with seating for the entire family! ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $112/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. * Must be 25 to Rent Sorry, no pets! FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
